image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a translucent green plastic disposable lighter lying on a dark surface. The lighter features a colorful graphic print on its side depicting a stylized blue and orange butterfly or abstract shape. There is black text printed near the top edge, partially legible as 'KISS' and other characters, appearing somewhat distorted. The metal guard and spark wheel assembly are visible at the top right. A blurry object (possibly a finger or another object) is visible in the top left corner.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black text printed on the green plastic is distorted and partially illegible. Characters appear to melt into each other or have inconsistent stroke widths, a common AI artifact when rendering text on curved surfaces.
The edges of the blue and orange graphic show slight bleeding into the green plastic background. The shading within the graphic lacks consistent light source logic compared to the rest of the object.
The geometry of the metal guard and spark wheel appears slightly warped; the parallel lines of the guard do not converge perfectly with the perspective of the lighter body.
